title: Montserrat scanned and found to carry a tridactyl fetus

tellings.quote: So, right now they're showing us the moment exact moment they discovered that she was pregnant when they were doing the scans because it happens live, so that's what they're showing us right now.

plain: A mummified three-fingered body from Peru, known as Montserrat, was found during medical scans to be carrying a fetus of its own, and the moment of discovery was caught live on the scan. Michels tells it himself from Peru, where the researchers showed him the footage of "the exact moment they discovered that she was pregnant." If the bodies are what their finders claim, a pregnancy would mean they were living beings that reproduced, not assembled objects.
